import io
import os
import runpy
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
repo = Path("..").resolve()
opens = set()
visits = set()

def hook(event, args):
    path = None
    if event == "open" and args:
        path = args[0]
    elif event in {"os.listdir", "os.scandir"} and args:
        path = args[0]
    elif event == "glob.glob" and args:
        path = args[0]
    if not isinstance(path, (str, bytes, os.PathLike)):
        return
    text = os.fsdecode(path)
    try:
        relative = Path(text).resolve().relative_to(repo).as_posix()
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return
    if relative.startswith(".git") or "/__pycache__/" in relative or relative.endswith(".pyc"):
        return
    if event == "open":
        opens.add(relative)
    else:
        visits.add(relative)

sys.addaudithook(hook)
sys.path[:0] = [str((repo / "ocor-runtime" / "src").resolve()), str(repo)]
sys.argv = ["pytest", "--collect-only", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "tests/"]
captured = io.StringIO()
sys.stdout = captured
code = 0
try:
    runpy.run_module("pytest", run_name="__main__")
except SystemExit as exc:
    code = int(exc.code) if isinstance(exc.code, int) else (0 if exc.code is None else 1)
sys.stdout = sys.__stdout__
text = captured.getvalue()
collected = "UNKNOWN"
for line in text.splitlines():
    if "tests collected" in line or line.strip() == "no tests collected":
        parts = line.split()
        collected = parts[0] if parts and parts[0].isdigit() else "0"
lines = [
    f"COLLECT_EXIT {code}",
    f"COLLECTED {collected}",
    f"OPEN_COUNT {len(opens)}",
    f"VISIT_COUNT {len(visits)}",
]
lines.extend("open\t" + item for item in sorted(opens))
lines.extend("visit\t" + item for item in sorted(visits))
sys.stdout.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
PY

import io
import os
import runpy
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
repo = Path("..").resolve()
opens = set()
visits = set()

def hook(event, args):
    path = None
    if event == "open" and args:
        path = args[0]
    elif event in {"os.listdir", "os.scandir"} and args:
        path = args[0]
    elif event == "glob.glob" and args:
        path = args[0]
    if not isinstance(path, (str, bytes, os.PathLike)):
        return
    text = os.fsdecode(path)
    try:
        relative = Path(text).resolve().relative_to(repo).as_posix()
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return
    if relative.startswith(".git") or "/__pycache__/" in relative or relative.endswith(".pyc"):
        return
    if event == "open":
        opens.add(relative)
    else:
        visits.add(relative)

sys.addaudithook(hook)
sys.path[:0] = [str((repo / "ocor-runtime" / "src").resolve()), str(repo)]
sys.argv = ["pytest", "--collect-only", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "tests/"]
captured = io.StringIO()
sys.stdout = captured
code = 0
try:
    runpy.run_module("pytest", run_name="__main__")
except SystemExit as exc:
    code = int(exc.code) if isinstance(exc.code, int) else (0 if exc.code is None else 1)
sys.stdout = sys.__stdout__
text = captured.getvalue()
collected = "UNKNOWN"
for line in text.splitlines():
    if "tests collected" in line or line.strip() == "no tests collected":
        parts = line.split()
        collected = parts[0] if parts and parts[0].isdigit() else "0"
lines = [
    f"COLLECT_EXIT {code}",
    f"COLLECTED {collected}",
    f"OPEN_COUNT {len(opens)}",
    f"VISIT_COUNT {len(visits)}",
]
lines.extend("open\t" + item for item in sorted(opens))
lines.extend("visit\t" + item for item in sorted(visits))
sys.stdout.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
PY
